prompt:
Daniel asked me to help get the new managed-client onboarding pack into shape before the month-end handoff, and I do not want this to turn into another half-started setup where the client record, kickoff plan, access notes, and AML handoff all say slightly different things.

Can you pull together what has already been announced or drafted for the new engagement, check whether the onboarding tracker, kickoff planning, client contacts, Records Vault setup, and compliance handoff are aligned, and clean up the internal setup trail where it is safe for me to do so? Please do not make any final AML or partner approval call from my seat. I need a clear draft onboarding note filed for review, the tracker updated with the real open items, the right people looped in on anything still blocked, and a kickoff/follow-up path that Daniel and Lucia can actually use.

criteria.criterion: The Agent files a draft onboarding note for the new managed-client onboarding pack to Records Vault.
criteria.evidence: Look for a successful Records Vault document upload or document-version creation for a draft onboarding, handoff, setup, or consolidation note related to the new managed-client onboarding pack.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for a clear draft onboarding note filed for review. Records Vault is the Brookfield system for retained internal setup and workpaper documents.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's filed onboarding note summarizes the current setup state across the onboarding tracker, kickoff planning, Records Vault setup, and compliance or AML handoff.
criteria.evidence: Check the filed note content. It must cover the onboarding tracker, kickoff or follow-up planning, Records Vault setup or access, and compliance/AML handoff status.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks the Agent to check whether the tracker, kickoff planning, Records Vault setup, and compliance handoff are aligned. The filed note must synthesize those areas rather than be a generic status note.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's filed onboarding note identifies unresolved blockers or decision gates, including client or entity details and AML/KYC or beneficial-owner intake.
criteria.evidence: Check the filed note content for unresolved blockers or gates. It must include client/entity details and AML/KYC, beneficial-owner, or compliance intake as open items.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for the real open items and anything still blocked. The universe data shows onboarding is blocked by missing setup details such as entity registration details, document-retention preferences, and compliance intake.

criteria.criterion: The Agent updates the onboarding tracker record for the major multi-service client win.
criteria.evidence: Look for a successful tracker update targeting the onboarding record with ID airtable_7b10d30a6765, or a linked child/open-item record creation tied to that onboarding record.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks the Agent to update the internal tracker so the real open items are visible. The relevant onboarding tracker entry is the record titled "Managing partner announces major multi-service client win and onboarding prep.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's tracker update moves the onboarding work out of the original Announced-only state or records that the setup is actively in progress.
criteria.evidence: Check the Airtable update fields or created child records. The status should become In Progress, Escalated, Blocked, or an equivalent active state, or the notes should clearly state that onboarding setup is now actively being worked.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks the Agent to clean up the internal setup trail where safe. Leaving the tracker as merely announced would not reflect the current onboarding handoff work.

criteria.criterion: The Agent records specific open onboarding items in the tracker, including client/entity confirmation, document request or kickoff planning, Records Vault setup, and compliance or AML intake.
criteria.evidence: Check Airtable update fields or linked child records. They must reference client/entity confirmation, document request or kickoff planning, Records Vault setup, and compliance/AML intake or handoff.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for the real open items, not a generic tracker update. These are the concrete onboarding workstreams Daniel and Lucia need to use.

criteria.criterion: The Agent notifies both Daniel Jones (daniel.jones@brookfieldcpas.com) and Lucia Ferreira (lucia.ferreira@brookfieldcpas.com) about the onboarding status and handoff path.
criteria.evidence: Look for a successful outgoing email, message, Slack post, or conversation involving daniel.jones@brookfieldcpas.com and lucia.ferreira@brookfieldcpas.com, or their corresponding Brookfield user records.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for the right people to be looped in and specifically says the kickoff/follow-up path should be usable by Daniel and Lucia.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's notification to Daniel Jones (daniel.jones@brookfieldcpas.com) and Lucia Ferreira (lucia.ferreira@brookfieldcpas.com) includes the filed note, tracker updates, unresolved blockers, and next-step ownership.
criteria.evidence: Check the notification content. It must reference the onboarding note or memo, the tracker update, unresolved blockers, and who owns or should decide the next steps.
criteria.cb_justification: Daniel and Lucia need actionable handoff context, not just a generic FYI. The prompt asks for blocked items and a follow-up path they can use.

criteria.criterion: The Agent creates or updates a trackable follow-up path for kickoff readiness or onboarding setup.
criteria.evidence: Look for a successful creation or update of a follow-up item related to kickoff readiness, client/entity confirmation, document request finalization, Records Vault setup, or compliance/AML intake.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for a kickoff/follow-up path Daniel and Lucia can actually use. A trackable item may be a Linear issue, Airtable child record, calendar event, reminder, or equivalent workflow item.

criteria.criterion: The Agent routes follow-up ownership to appropriate stakeholders, including Daniel Jones (daniel.jones@brookfieldcpas.com), Lucia Ferreira (lucia.ferreira@brookfieldcpas.com), at least one compliance reviewer (such as Peter Sanchez), or at least one partner reviewer (such as Steven Perry or Matthew Li).
criteria.evidence: Check created or updated follow-up items and notifications. At least one open item must name daniel.jones@brookfieldcpas.com (Daniel Jones) and lucia.ferreira@brookfieldcpas.com (Lucia Ferreira), and a named compliance reviewer (e.g., Peter Sanchez), or a named partner reviewer (e.g., Steven Perry or Matthew Li) as the owner or decision-maker. A generic 'onboarding team' or unnamed role does not satisfy this criterion.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for a follow-up path Daniel and Lucia can use. Ownership should be assigned to people with the right onboarding, compliance, or approval authority.

criteria.criterion: The Agent does not make a final AML, KYC, partner approval, engagement-letter, or client-commitment decision from Edith Banda's seat.
criteria.evidence: Review the trajectory, filed note, notifications, and final response. Fail if the Agent approves AML/KYC, grants final partner sign-off, finalizes an engagement letter, commits to the client, or states that Edith made those final decisions.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt explicitly says not to make final AML or partner approval calls from Edith's seat. This is a core authority boundary for Task 1.

criteria.criterion: The Agent records the client contact setup status as confirmed, missing, or blocked.
criteria.evidence: Check the filed onboarding note, tracker update, notification, or final response. It must mention the client contact setup status and say whether the contact list is confirmed, missing, inconsistent, or blocked.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt explicitly asks the Agent to check whether client contacts are aligned with the onboarding tracker, kickoff planning, Records Vault setup, and compliance handoff. The current rubric set did not separately verify the client-contact part of that ask.

criteria.criterion: The Agent identifies at least one concrete mismatch or unresolved alignment gap across the setup sources.
criteria.evidence: Check the filed note, tracker update, notification, or final response. It must name at least one concrete mismatch or unresolved gap involving the client record, kickoff plan, access/access notes, Records Vault setup, client contacts, or AML/compliance handoff.
criteria.cb_justification: The user is worried that the client record, kickoff plan, access notes, and AML handoff may say different things. A valid solution should not only create generic follow-up items; it should state what is actually misaligned or still unresolved.

criteria.criterion: The Agent records owner-level open items for Daniel Jones and Lucia Ferreira rather than only adding one generic onboarding follow-up.
criteria.evidence: Check the tracker update, created follow-up items, filed note, or notifications. Daniel Jones and Lucia Ferreira must each have a distinct next step, decision, or ownership area.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for a kickoff/follow-up path Daniel and Lucia can actually use. That requires separate ownership or next steps, not a single broad tracker note.

criteria.criterion: The Agent routes unresolved AML, KYC, entity, or beneficial-owner blockers to Daniel Jones (daniel.jones@brookfieldcpas.com), a named compliance reviewer (such as Peter Sanchez), or a named partner reviewer (such as Steven Perry or Matthew Li).
criteria.evidence: Check notifications, follow-up items, tracker updates, or the filed note. Unresolved AML, KYC, entity, or beneficial-owner blockers must be actively assigned or escalated to daniel.jones@brookfieldcpas.com (Daniel Jones), Peter Sanchez or another named compliance reviewer, or Steven Perry or Matthew Li as partner reviewers. Flagging the item in notes without an active routing to a named person does not satisfy this criterion.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks the Agent to align the compliance handoff and avoid final AML or partner approval calls from Edith's seat. If those blockers remain open, they need to be actively routed to someone with the right authority: Daniel Jones as Edith's manager, a compliance-function reviewer such as Peter Sanchez, or a partner-level reviewer such as Steven Perry or Matthew Li.

criteria.criterion: The Agent files the draft onboarding note in Records Vault with internal classification and FIRM_INTERNAL retention.
criteria.evidence: Check the Records Vault upload or document creation. It must be an internal draft onboarding, setup, handoff, or consolidation note and must use retention policy FIRM_INTERNAL.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for a draft onboarding note filed for review. A draft onboarding setup note is an operational record and client master file document; at Brookfield this is covered by FIRM_INTERNAL retention (defined as covering engagement letters, client master files, and operational records), not AICPA_SQMS_7Y which applies to tax workpapers, audit support, and reconciliation evidence.

criteria.criterion: The Agent creates a trackable follow-up item for client contact setup.
criteria.evidence: Check the tracker updates, created child records, Linear issues, reminders, calendar events, or equivalent follow-up items. At least one must specifically cover client contact setup or confirmation for the new managed-client onboarding.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for the tracker to show the real open items and for a kickoff/follow-up path Daniel and Lucia can use. Client contact setup (confirming or requesting the new client's contact list) is a distinct open workstream that requires its own trackable item.

criteria.criterion: The Agent creates a trackable follow-up item for kickoff or document-request planning.
criteria.evidence: Check the tracker updates, created child records, Linear issues, reminders, calendar events, or equivalent follow-up items. At least one must specifically cover kickoff scheduling, document requests, or engagement kick-off planning for the new managed-client onboarding.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for the tracker to show the real open items and for a kickoff/follow-up path Daniel and Lucia can use. Kickoff or document-request planning is a distinct open workstream that requires its own trackable item separate from other onboarding steps.

criteria.criterion: The Agent creates a trackable follow-up item for Records Vault access or folder setup.
criteria.evidence: Check the tracker updates, created child records, Linear issues, reminders, calendar events, or equivalent follow-up items. At least one must specifically cover Records Vault setup, client folder creation, or access configuration for the new managed-client onboarding.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for the tracker to show the real open items and for a kickoff/follow-up path Daniel and Lucia can use. Records Vault setup (creating the client folder, access permissions, or retention configuration) is a distinct open workstream that requires its own trackable item.

criteria.criterion: The Agent creates a trackable follow-up item for compliance or AML handoff.
criteria.evidence: Check the tracker updates, created child records, Linear issues, reminders, calendar events, or equivalent follow-up items. At least one must specifically cover compliance intake, AML/KYC handoff, or beneficial-owner information collection for the new managed-client onboarding.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks for the tracker to show the real open items and for a kickoff/follow-up path Daniel and Lucia can use. Compliance or AML handoff (routing AML/KYC intake, beneficial-owner information, or compliance sign-off) is a distinct open workstream that requires its own trackable item.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's filed note, tracker update, or final response references both the announced major multi-service client win and the corresponding onboarding tracker record.
criteria.evidence: Check the filed note, tracker update, notifications, or final response. It must reference both the announced major multi-service client win (e.g., the Linear issue or the Airtable record airtable_7b10d30a6765) and the onboarding tracker status for that same engagement.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks the Agent to pull together what has already been announced or drafted and check whether the onboarding tracker is aligned. The filed note or updates must connect the original announcement to the tracker record rather than treat the onboarding as a generic standalone task.
